desc: Fill your kitchen with the scent of deliciously soft home-baked cookies in minutes! Betty Crocker Soft Baked Chocolate Caramel Flavored Cookie Mix makes it easy to whip up a batch of cookies, any time. Just follow the steps on the package to combine the cookie mix with butter or margarine, water, and eggs, then bake about 15 to 17 minutes. For a sweet twist, top finished cookies with Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Frosting and chopped pecans once they've cooled. Whether you're looking for a dessert table treat, a snack after lunch, or a tasty addition to a baked goods gift basket, soft baked chocolate caramel flavored cookies make every moment special. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing tasty dessert mixes, frosting, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
SOFT BAKED COOKIE MIX: Betty Crocker makes baking a batch of soft chocolate caramel flavored cookies for the family quick and convenient (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

EASY TO MAKE: Just stir the cookie mix with softened butter, water, and eggs; Roll the dough into balls, add to a cookie sheet, and bake about 15 to 17 minutes

YUMMY POSSIBILITIES: Prepare cookies as is or top every baked cookie with Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Frosting and chopped pecans

ANYTIME TREAT: Serve your finished cookies as snacks, a kids party food, or an after dinner dessert; A tasty addition to a baked goods gift basket, college care package, and more

CONTAINS: One 16.4 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Soft Baked Chocolate Caramel Flavored Cookie Mix; About 22 servings per pouch
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Caramel Flavored Confectionery Chips (sugar, vegetable oil [palm kernel and/or palm], nonfat milk, color added, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Palm Oil, Modified Corn Starch, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Mono and Diglycerides, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Nonfat Milk.
